content_sections.heading: ICAR-NBSS&LUP Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR-NBSS&LUP Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview is scheduled for 18 August 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 42,000/- per month (fixed) for the Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) position.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have a Post graduate/graduate degree in fields like Computer Science and Engineering, Computer Applications, Geoinformatics, Remote Sensing & GIS, Soil Science, Agricultural Physics, Data Science & Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Geology, or Geography.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) post?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government rules for SC/ST/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the ICAR-NBSS&LUP Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a walk-in recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates need to attend the walk-in interview on the specified date and venue with all required documents.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at ICAR-National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning, Nagpur, Maharashtra, 440033.

faq.question: Q8. What documents do I need to carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable), along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any work experience required for this post?
faq.answer: While not mandatory, one year of working experience in Machine Learning, Big Data Analytics, and Remote Sensing, along with working knowledge in spatial database handling, management, and analysis in GIS, is considered desirable.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The position of Young Professional-II (RS&GIS) is on a contractual basis.
